table.retrieve:
SELECT Item.CustomICode,    
         Item.Name,   
			active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
         Item.PackUnits,   
         ItemPacking.Name,   
         GodownDetail.Batch,   
         GodownDetail.Expiry,   
         Item.AvgPrice,   
         GodownDetail.CurrQty,
			manufacturer=manufacturer.name  ,
			Manfcode=item.manfcode,
			gcode=godowndetail.gcode,
			godown=(select name from godown where gcode=godowndetail.gcode)
    FROM GodownDetail,   
		Item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (item.packcode = ItemPacking.packcode),
         manufacturer
			  
   WHERE case :as_group when 'P' then item.packcode
						when 'C' THEN item.icatcode
						when 'L' THEN item.iccode
						when 'M' THEN item.manfcode  end  IN (:aa_manfcode) and
			( item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode)and
			( Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode ) and  
         ( ( GodownDetail.Expiry <= DateAdd(day, :ar_date, GetDate()) ) )    
 order by manufacturer.name  ,
			 Item.name

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: 'Report Input :' + case( as_group when 'P' then 'Packing' 	when 'C' THEN 'Category' when 'L' THEN 'Class' when 'M' THEN 'Manufacturer')
